free_findings.cause: The cache key includes report_id but omits tenant.
free_findings.impact: A tenant can receive another tenant's export content and filename, bypassing database ownership enforcement.
free_findings.trigger: Tenant A downloads report ID 7, populating the cache; tenant B then requests report ID 7 through the same service.
free_findings.evidence: key = report_id shares the cached metadata across tenants. Cache hits skip repository.lookup(tenant, report_id), and download reads the cached export path.

free_findings.cause: String prefix matching replaces path-component containment checking.
free_findings.impact: Downloads can read files outside the permitted export storage root.
free_findings.trigger: With storage_root /srv/exports, metadata contains ../exports-private/secret.csv and that file exists.
free_findings.evidence: The resolved target /srv/exports-private/secret.csv starts with /srv/exports, so the new check accepts it. The base is_relative_to check rejects this sibling directory.

free_findings.cause: Replacing the repository leaves metadata cached from the previous repository indefinitely.
free_findings.impact: Refreshed metadata remains unavailable for cached reports; downloads can return outdated exports or fail if an outdated path no longer exists.
free_findings.trigger: A report is cached, rotate_connection installs a repository returning an updated path or filename for that report, and the report is downloaded again.
free_findings.evidence: replace_repository only assigns self.repository. metadata queries the repository only when the key is absent, and no cache invalidation or refresh mechanism is included.

free_findings.cause: The descriptive local name metadata is replaced with zz.
free_findings.impact: The export path and filename accesses become harder to understand during maintenance.
free_findings.trigger: A maintainer reads or modifies download's metadata handling.
free_findings.evidence: The diff renames metadata to zz without changing its role. Restoring a descriptive name is an optional readability improvement.

free_findings.cause: A helper for a retired adapter is added without any caller.
free_findings.impact: Unused code increases maintenance surface without supporting the requested cache or repository rotation behavior.
free_findings.trigger: The supplied implementation and callers are used as provided; no execution path calls this helper.
free_findings.evidence: All implementation and callers are included, and _format_content_disposition appears only in its definition. Its docstring identifies the consumer as retired. Removing it is optional cleanup.

limitations: Review used only the embedded frozen base, candidate, requirements, and diff; no tools or external sources were used.
No tests were executed. Failing conditions were established by static inspection.
No cache expiration interval, capacity limit, or concurrency contract was specified, so none was inferred.
Every function in the candidate has a docstring, satisfying the stated repository policy.
